limits: Not an independent review, continuous human-feel assessment, audio validation or hardware benchmark. No score or AAA certification.

nextDesign.problem: Repeated cover collisions and obscured last approaches consume attention and exposure before players can make combat decisions. More overlay instructions have not resolved the issue.
nextDesign.decision: Reauthor the opening approach and receiver access as physical service aisles with cover on their shoulders. Give receivers a recognizable silhouette and readable identity from the actual north/south and courtyard approaches. Use original Blender assets and shared placement/collision metadata.
requirements: Preserve all historical assets/evidence, mission locations, reach2.8m, hold.9s, combat/movement/phase/boss/anchor/upload rules. Geometry/LOS/exposure intentionally change and must be measured, not claimed equivalent.

Opening from spawn toward each archive must offer a visible generous grounded route around the induction guard. The warning sign cannot hang across an apparent walk/vault path. Solid cover stays at the shoulders and optional flank/vault choices remain.
Audit entry desire lines past the existing first service platforms, not just the first barricade. Do not replace the level with an empty or invulnerable corridor.

At each receiver expose at least two genuine final approaches connected to its existing reach ring without a machinery or sign dead end. Keep useful encounter cover, architectural support and meaningful tactical exposure. Current recovery positions and game rules stay fixed.

Original Blender-native/GLB/provenance with new Build70 stem; render/fallback/collision/map/nav/rain all describe the same solids. New bounds must be correctly built before caches. Thin paint can be non-solid; visible rigid fittings cannot become ghost obstacles.
Use grounded world geometry and receiver identity, not another HUD panel, more competing hints, automatic movement/aim, resource increases or forced win tuning.

Compare before/after from the root opening obstruction and east/Heart approach screenshots, standing/crouch/vault views, and render actual clear walking paths. Capsule-swept connectivity with normal movement, supported architecture, shot cover, navigation/pursuit/receiver/phase/anchor and forced fallback checks.
